engineer.description: Primary coding agent. Model follows the session model.

reviewer.description: Read-only diff reviewer. Reports concrete defects only.

verifier.description: Runs verification commands and reports compact results. Never edits files.

plan.description: Plan a task without editing files
plan.template:
Plan the following work. Explore the code first, then produce a concrete step-by-step plan: files to touch, order of operations, risks, and how to verify. Do not edit files.

$ARGUMENTS

explore.description: Delegate a read-only investigation to the explore subagent
explore.template:
Investigate and report. Questions:

$ARGUMENTS

Output format:
- FILES: exact paths with line numbers
- FACTS: only what you verified by reading, no speculation
- UNCERTAIN: what you could not determine
Keep it under 500 words.

review.template:
Review the current uncommitted diff. Report only concrete defects with file:line and evidence, highest severity first, maximum 7 findings. No style nitpicks, no praise. If there is nothing, say NO FINDINGS.

$ARGUMENTS

verify.description: Run the project's checks and report results
verify.template:
Verify the current changes. If a command is given below, run exactly that command. Otherwise detect the standard test, lint, and typecheck commands from the repository manifests and run only those. Do not modify any files.

$ARGUMENTS

handoff.description: Write a compact handoff for a fresh session
handoff.template:
Write a handoff for a fresh session. Terse, no process narration. Sections: GOAL, DECISIONS, CHANGED FILES, OPEN QUESTIONS, NEXT ACTION.

$ARGUMENTS
